People will always want to make room for
winners, and winners have to say no to everyone else. Recently, there was a
relatively large influencer who reached out to me, and they were like, "Hey, I
would love to connect." And I was like, "I know what I need to do right now to
get us to where we want to go, and there's probably nothing that this
person is going to say that is going to in any way increase the
likelihood that that occurs." And I said, "No."
Thinking about it from like, how will this change my activities? Help at least
does for me say no to the hundreds and thousands of things that want to take
your attention. And I would strongly recommend, as fast as humanly possible,
being okay with people not liking you, not understanding you, and thinking that
you are different than them, because you are. You're a winner.
